players.product: on-premises superconducting quantum computers (five-qubit IQM Spark; IQM Radiance, approximately 20 to 150 qubits) and IQM Resonance cloud

quarterly_data.signal: Partner Telefonica: Telefonica and IQM will provide the Community of Madrid with its first quantum computer, an IQM Spark to be installed at the Universidad Politecnica de Madrid before the end of 2026; it will be the third system deployed in Spain through the IQM-Telefonica collaboration, after the two supplied to CESGA (Galician Supercomputing Centre). CEO Jan Goetz: 'By investing in its own quantum computer, the Community of Madrid is creating an infrastructure that will enable its researchers, students and industries to grow their capabilities over the long term.'
